source.text: לֹא־תִזְבַּח֩ לַיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ שׁ֣וֹר וָשֶׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם כֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֣ר רָ֑ע כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הֽוּא׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall sacrifice to Yahweh your God ox or sheep which will be in it a blemish, any thing bad, for [the] abomination of Yahweh your God [is] it.

en.L: You shall not sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God an ox or a sheep that has a blemish in it, any bad thing, for that [is] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Do not sacrifice an ox or a sheep or goat to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God if it has a defect or anything wrong with it, because that is detestable to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Do not offer {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God a bull, a sheep or a goat that has something wrong with it. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God hates that.

es.L: No sacrificarás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios buey ni oveja en que haya defecto, alguna cosa mala, porque abominación {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios [es] eso.
es.B: No sacrifiques {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios un buey, una oveja o una cabra que tenga un defecto o algo malo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo detesta.
es.R: No ofrezcas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios un toro, una oveja o una cabra que tenga algo malo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios odia eso.

fr.L: Tu ne sacrifieras pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu de bœuf ni de mouton qui ait en lui un défaut, quoi que ce soit de mauvais, car c’[est] une abomination pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: N’offre pas en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu un bœuf, un mouton ou une chèvre qui a un défaut ou quoi que ce soit de mauvais, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’a en horreur.
fr.R: N’offre pas {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu un taureau, un mouton ou une chèvre qui a quelque chose qui ne va pas. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu déteste cela.

sw.L: Usimchinjie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ng'ombe wala kondoo aliye na kasoro ndani yake, kitu chochote kibaya, kwa maana hilo [ni] chukizo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Usimtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako dhabihu ya ng'ombe, kondoo au mbuzi mwenye kasoro au tatizo lolote, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anachukia kabisa jambo hilo.
sw.R: Usimtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako fahali, kondoo au mbuzi mwenye tatizo lolote. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anachukia jambo hilo.

decisions.choice: a blemish, any bad thing: any defect that makes the animal unfit to be offered
decisions.reason: An animal given to God had to be whole. Leviticus 22:17-25 lists the defects that rule an animal out, and 15:21 applies the same rule to firstborn animals. To offer a lame or sick animal is to treat God with contempt (Malachi 1:8, 13-14).

decisions.choice: abomination: something the LORD finds detestable and will not accept
decisions.reason: The word names what is utterly offensive to God. Deuteronomy uses it for idols (7:25-26), for the worship of other gods (13:15), for unclean food (14:3) and for dishonest weights (25:16). The same word returns in verse 4 for the worship of other gods, which ties this verse to the case that follows.

decisions.choice: sheep: one animal of the flock, a sheep or a goat
decisions.reason: The word means a single animal from the flock and covers both sheep and goats (14:4; Exodus 12:5).

decisions.choice: still Moses speaking: part of the speech that began at 5:1
decisions.reason: The chapter lies inside Moses' long speech of 5:1-26:19, so no new speech begins here. This verse closes a short run of rules about worship (16:21-17:1): no sacred pole beside the altar, no standing stone, and no flawed sacrifice.

decisions.choice: detestable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "abomination". Balanced says "detestable", an everyday word for the same strong dislike, and Readable says plainly that the LORD hates it.

decisions.choice: a sheep or goat
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name both animals the word covers (see the meaning decision); Literal keeps the single word "sheep". Readable says "bull" for the large animal offered, which is the usual sense of the word in sacrifice.

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel through the chapter, with the plural_you span only in verse 16, where the Hebrew turns to the plural
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1, 7 and 16, Spanish follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level, since Spanish, unlike English, can show it.

decisions.choice: "tu" for Israel through the chapter, "vous" only in verse 16, where the Hebrew turns to the plural
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1, 7 and 16, French follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level, since French, unlike English, can show it.

decisions.choice: singular forms ("Mungu wako", "usimchinjie") through the chapter, plural forms only in verse 16, where the Hebrew turns to the plural
decisions.reason: As in chapters 1, 7 and 16, Swahili follows the Hebrew number of "you" at every level, since Swahili, unlike English, can show it.

source.text: כִּֽי־יִמָּצֵ֤א בְקִרְבְּךָ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ אִ֣ישׁ אוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה אֶת־הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: If is found in your midst, in one of your gates which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you, a man or a woman who does the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh your God, to transgress his covenant,

en.L: If there is found in your midst, in one of your gates that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, transgressing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant,
en.B: If a man or a woman is found among you, in one of the towns that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, doing what is evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and breaking {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant,
en.R: Someone, a man or a woman, may be living in one of the towns {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, and may do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God says is evil. That person is breaking {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant.

es.L: Si se halla en medio de ti, en una de tus puertas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, un hombre o una mujer que hace lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, traspasando {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto,
es.B: Si en medio de ti, en alguna de las ciudades que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, se encuentra un hombre o una mujer que hace lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios y quebranta {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto,
es.R: Puede ser que alguien, hombre o mujer, que vive en una de las ciudades que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, haga lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios dice que es malo. Esa persona está rompiendo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto.

fr.L: S’il se trouve au milieu de toi, dans l’une de tes portes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, un homme ou une femme qui fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, en transgressant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance,
fr.B: Si l’on trouve chez toi, dans l’une des villes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, un homme ou une femme qui fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu et qui viole {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance,
fr.R: Il peut arriver qu’une personne, un homme ou une femme, qui vit dans l’une des villes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, fasse ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu déclare mauvais. Cette personne viole {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance.

sw.L: Akionekana katikati yako, katika mojawapo ya malango yako ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa, mwanamume au mwanamke atendaye yaliyo maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, akilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}},
sw.B: Ikiwa miongoni mwako, katika mmojawapo wa miji ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa, ataonekana mwanamume au mwanamke anayetenda yaliyo maovu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}},
sw.R: Huenda mtu fulani, mwanamume au mwanamke, anayeishi katika mmojawapo wa miji ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa, akafanya jambo ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anasema ni ovu. Mtu huyo analivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

decisions.choice: if ... is found: one long condition running through verse 4, with the verdict in verse 5
decisions.reason: Verses 2-4 set out the case: someone is found worshiping other gods, it is reported, and it is proved. Only then does verse 5 give the sentence. The law is built so that the investigation comes before the punishment.

decisions.choice: your gates: your towns
decisions.reason: The gate of a walled town was its public square and the place where the elders and judges sat to hear cases (16:18; 21:19; 22:15; Ruth 4:1). "Your gates" stands for the towns themselves, and also points to the place where such a case would be heard.

decisions.choice: to transgress his covenant: the worship of other gods breaks the covenant itself
decisions.reason: The covenant made at Horeb begins with the command to have no other gods (5:6-9). Serving other gods is not one wrong among many but a breach of the whole relationship, which is why chapter 13 and this passage treat it so gravely.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "gates". Balanced and Readable say "towns", the thing the word stands for here; Literal keeps "gates".

source.text: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַֽיַּעֲבֹד֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָהֶ֑ם וְלַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ׀א֣וֹ לַיָּרֵ֗חַ א֛וֹ לְכָל־צְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־צִוִּֽיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: and has gone and served other gods and bowed down to them, or to the sun or to the moon or to any of [the] host of the heavens, which not I have commanded,

en.L: and has gone and served other gods and bowed down to them, or to the sun or to the moon or to any of the host of the heavens, which I have not commanded,
en.B: who has gone and served other gods and bowed down to them, or to the sun or the moon or any of the stars in the sky, which I have not commanded,
en.R: That person goes and serves other gods and bows down to them, or to the sun or the moon or the stars. I have never commanded that.

es.L: y ha ido y ha servido a otros dioses y se ha postrado ante ellos, o ante el sol o ante la luna o ante cualquiera del ejército de los cielos, lo cual yo no he mandado,
es.B: que ha ido a servir a otros dioses y se ha postrado ante ellos, o ante el sol, la luna o cualquiera de las estrellas del cielo, cosa que yo no he mandado,
es.R: Esa persona va y sirve a otros dioses y se inclina ante ellos, o ante el sol, la luna o las estrellas. Yo nunca he mandado eso.

fr.L: et qui est allé, et a servi d’autres dieux, et s’est prosterné devant eux, ou devant le soleil, ou devant la lune, ou devant quoi que ce soit de l’armée des cieux, ce que je n’ai pas commandé,
fr.B: qui est allé servir d’autres dieux et s’est prosterné devant eux, ou devant le soleil, la lune ou l’une des étoiles du ciel, ce que je n’ai pas commandé,
fr.R: Cette personne va servir d’autres dieux et se prosterne devant eux, ou devant le soleil, la lune ou les étoiles. Je n’ai jamais commandé cela.

sw.L: na amekwenda na kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia, au jua au mwezi au chochote cha jeshi la mbinguni, jambo ambalo sikuliamuru,
sw.B: ambaye amekwenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia, au kulisujudia jua, mwezi au nyota yoyote ya angani, jambo ambalo sikuliamuru,
sw.R: Mtu huyo anakwenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia, au kulisujudia jua, mwezi au nyota. Sijawahi kamwe kuamuru jambo hilo.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the stars and the other lights of the sky, worshiped as gods
decisions.reason: The peoples around Israel worshiped the sun, the moon and the stars as divine powers. Moses has already warned against it (4:19), and later kings of Judah brought this worship into the temple itself (2 Kings 21:3-5; 23:5).

decisions.choice: which I have not commanded: which is forbidden
decisions.reason: The words understate the case: what has not been commanded here is what has been expressly forbidden (4:15-19; 5:7-9).

decisions.choice: I: Moses, speaking as the one who passes on God's commands
decisions.reason: Throughout the speech Moses calls God's commands "what I command you" (4:2; 6:6; 11:13), and at times his words pass into God's own voice (7:4; 11:14-15; 29:4-5). Whichever voice is heard here, the command is God's.

decisions.choice: served ... bowed down: worship in act and in posture
decisions.reason: The two verbs together describe full worship: serving with offerings and rites, and bowing down before the god or its image. The pair repeats the words of the second commandment (5:9).

decisions.choice: the stars in the sky
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the host of the heavens", a picture of the stars as a great army. Balanced and Readable name what is meant, the stars.

decisions.choice: I have never commanded that.
decisions.reason: Readable makes the clause a short sentence of its own. It keeps "I", leaving the speaker as open as the Hebrew does.

source.text: וְהֻֽגַּד־לְךָ֖ וְשָׁמָ֑עְתָּ וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֣ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֱמֶת֙ נָכ֣וֹן הַדָּבָ֔ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֛ה הַתּוֹעֵבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: and it is told to you and you hear, and you investigate thoroughly, and look, truth, certain [is] the thing, has been done the abomination the this in Israel,

en.L: and it is told to you and you hear [of it], then you shall investigate thoroughly; and if it is true, the matter certain, [that] this abomination has been done in Israel,
en.B: and you are told about it, then you must investigate it carefully. If it is true and the charge is proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,
en.R: If someone tells you about this, you must look into it carefully. You may find that the report is true and that this terrible thing really has been done in Israel.

es.L: y te es contado y [lo] oyes, entonces investigarás bien; y si es verdad, cierta la cosa, [que] esta abominación ha sido hecha en Israel,
es.B: y te lo informan, entonces debes investigarlo cuidadosamente. Si es verdad y se comprueba la acusación de que esta cosa detestable se ha hecho en Israel,
es.R: Si alguien te habla de esto, debes averiguarlo con cuidado. Tal vez descubras que el informe es verdadero y que esta cosa terrible de verdad se ha hecho en Israel.

fr.L: et que cela t’est rapporté et que tu [l’]entends, alors tu feras une enquête minutieuse ; et si c’est la vérité, si la chose est certaine, [que] cette abomination a été commise en Israël,
fr.B: et qu’on t’en informe, alors tu dois faire une enquête minutieuse. Si c’est vrai et que l’accusation est prouvée, si cet acte abominable a été commis en Israël,
fr.R: Si quelqu’un te le rapporte, tu dois examiner l’affaire avec soin. Tu découvriras peut-être que le rapport est vrai et que cette chose terrible a vraiment été faite en Israël.

sw.L: nawe ukaambiwa na ukasikia [habari hiyo], basi utachunguza kwa makini; na ikiwa ni kweli, jambo hilo ni hakika, [kwamba] chukizo hili limefanyika katika Israeli,
sw.B: nawe ukaambiwa habari hiyo, basi lazima uichunguze kwa makini. Ikiwa ni kweli na shtaka limethibitika kwamba jambo hili la kuchukiza limefanyika katika Israeli,
sw.R: Mtu akikuambia habari hii, lazima uichunguze kwa makini. Huenda ukagundua kwamba habari hiyo ni kweli na kwamba jambo hili baya kabisa kweli limefanyika katika Israeli.

decisions.choice: investigate thoroughly: no one is condemned on a rumor
decisions.reason: The same demand for a careful inquiry stands in the case of a town led into idolatry (13:15) and in the case of a false witness (19:18). A report starts the case; it does not decide it.

decisions.choice: true, the matter certain: proved beyond doubt
decisions.reason: Two words are set side by side, "truth" and "established", to say that the charge must be shown to be firmly true, as in 13:15.

decisions.choice: and look: if it turns out that
decisions.reason: The little word that usually means "look" here marks what the investigation finds, so it has the force of "and if it turns out".

decisions.choice: in Israel: an offense against the whole people
decisions.reason: The deed is done by one person in one town, but it is called a detestable thing done "in Israel": it stains the people of the covenant as a whole (22:21).

decisions.choice: [of it] ... then
decisions.reason: Literal supplies what "hear" refers to, and says "then" for the "and" that starts the main clause after the condition.

source.text: וְהֽוֹצֵאתָ֣ אֶת־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֡וּא אוֹ֩ אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֨ה הַהִ֜וא אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָ֠שׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֨ר הָרָ֤ע הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֶת־הָאִ֕ישׁ א֖וֹ אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וּסְקַלְתָּ֥ם בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וָמֵֽתוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and you shall bring out that man or that woman who have done the thing the evil the this to your gates, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.

en.L: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
en.B: then you are to bring out to your town gates the man or the woman who has done this evil thing, and stone that person to death.
en.R: Then take the man or woman who did this evil thing out to the gates of your town. Kill that person by throwing stones.

es.L: entonces sacarás a tus puertas a ese hombre o a esa mujer que ha hecho esta mala cosa, al hombre o a la mujer, y los apedrearás con piedras, y morirán.
es.B: entonces sacarás a las puertas de tu ciudad al hombre o a la mujer que haya hecho esta maldad, y apedrearás a esa persona hasta que muera.
es.R: Entonces lleva al hombre o a la mujer que hizo esta maldad a las puertas de tu ciudad. Mata a esa persona tirándole piedras.

fr.L: alors tu feras sortir vers tes portes cet homme ou cette femme qui a commis cette mauvaise action, l’homme ou la femme, et tu les lapideras avec des pierres, et ils mourront.
fr.B: alors tu feras sortir jusqu’aux portes de ta ville l’homme ou la femme qui a commis cette mauvaise action, et tu lapideras cette personne jusqu’à ce qu’elle meure.
fr.R: Alors emmène l’homme ou la femme qui a fait cette mauvaise action jusqu’aux portes de ta ville. Tue cette personne en lui jetant des pierres.

sw.L: basi utamtoa mwanamume huyo au mwanamke huyo aliyetenda jambo hili ovu hadi malangoni mwako, mwanamume au mwanamke, nawe utawapiga kwa mawe, nao watakufa.
sw.B: basi umtoe hadi kwenye malango ya mji wako mwanamume au mwanamke aliyetenda jambo hili ovu, na umpige mtu huyo mawe mpaka afe.
sw.R: Kisha mpeleke mwanamume au mwanamke aliyefanya jambo hili ovu nje kwenye malango ya mji wako. Muue mtu huyo kwa kumpiga mawe.

decisions.choice: bring out ... to your gates: to the town gate, the public place of judgment
decisions.reason: The guilty person is led out to the gate, where the town's court sat, and is put to death outside the town, in public (22:24; Leviticus 24:14; 1 Kings 21:13).

decisions.choice: the man or the woman: the law applies to both alike
decisions.reason: The phrase is said twice in this verse, after being named in verse 2. The repetition makes clear that a woman found guilty of this is judged in the same way as a man.

decisions.choice: stone them: the whole community carries out the sentence
decisions.reason: Stoning was done by the people together, with the witnesses beginning (verse 7; 13:10-11). It made the whole community take part in removing the wrong from among them.

decisions.choice: stone that person to death
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "stone them with stones, and they shall die". Balanced and Readable say it once. They say "that person" for the Hebrew "them", which refers to the one man or woman found guilty.

source.text: עַל־פִּ֣י׀שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עֵדִ֖ים יוּמַ֣ת הַמֵּ֑ת לֹ֣א יוּמַ֔ת עַל־פִּ֖י עֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall be put to death the dying [one]; not shall he be put to death on [the] mouth of witness one.

en.L: On the word of two witnesses or three witnesses the one who is to die shall be put to death; he shall not be put to death on the word of one witness.
en.B: A person may be put to death only when two or three witnesses give evidence. The word of one witness is not enough to put anyone to death.
en.R: Two or three people must say they saw it before anyone can be put to death. If only one person gives evidence, that is not enough.

es.L: Por la palabra de dos testigos o de tres testigos se dará muerte al que ha de morir; no se le dará muerte por la palabra de un solo testigo.
es.B: Solo se puede dar muerte a una persona cuando dos o tres testigos declaran contra ella. La palabra de un solo testigo no basta para dar muerte a nadie.
es.R: Dos o tres personas deben decir que lo vieron antes de que se pueda matar a alguien. Si solo una persona da testimonio, no es suficiente.

fr.L: Sur la parole de deux témoins ou de trois témoins, on fera mourir celui qui doit mourir ; on ne le fera pas mourir sur la parole d’un seul témoin.
fr.B: Une personne ne peut être mise à mort que si deux ou trois témoins déposent contre elle. La parole d’un seul témoin ne suffit pas pour faire mourir quelqu’un.
fr.R: Avant que quelqu’un soit mis à mort, deux ou trois personnes doivent dire qu’elles l’ont vu faire. Si une seule personne témoigne, cela ne suffit pas.

sw.L: Kwa neno la mashahidi wawili au mashahidi watatu yule anayepaswa kufa atauawa; hatauawa kwa neno la shahidi mmoja.
sw.B: Mtu anaweza kuuawa tu ikiwa mashahidi wawili au watatu wametoa ushahidi. Neno la shahidi mmoja halitoshi kumuua mtu yeyote.
sw.R: Watu wawili au watatu lazima waseme kwamba waliona jambo hilo kabla mtu hajauawa. Ikiwa mtu mmoja tu ndiye anayetoa ushahidi, hiyo haitoshi.

decisions.choice: on the mouth of: on the testimony of
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what a person says. A sentence is passed "on the mouth of" witnesses when it rests on what they testify.

decisions.choice: the dying one: the person who is to die, the one condemned
decisions.reason: The word is a participle, "the one dying". Here it means the person whose case could end in death, the accused who is sentenced.

decisions.choice: two or three witnesses: a rule repeated in the law and in the New Testament
decisions.reason: The rule is given for murder in Numbers 35:30 and for every charge in 19:15. Jesus and Paul apply it to discipline in the church (Matthew 18:16; 2 Corinthians 13:1; 1 Timothy 5:19).

decisions.choice: only when ... is not enough
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the rule as one condition and one limit, for clarity. Literal keeps the Hebrew's two parallel clauses.

source.text: יַ֣ד הָעֵדִ֞ים תִּֽהְיֶה־בּ֤וֹ בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ לַהֲמִית֔וֹ וְיַ֥ד כָּל־הָעָ֖ם בָּאַחֲרֹנָ֑ה וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: [The] hand of the witnesses shall be against him at first to put him to death, and [the] hand of all the people at last; and you shall remove the evil from your midst.

en.L: The hand of the witnesses shall be against him first, to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward. So you shall remove the evil from your midst.
en.B: The witnesses must be the first to raise their hands to put that person to death, and then all the people are to join in. In this way you will remove the evil from among you.
en.R: The witnesses must throw the first stones, and then everyone else must join in. This is how you must get rid of the evil among you.

es.L: La mano de los testigos estará contra él primero para darle muerte, y la mano de todo el pueblo después. Así quitarás el mal de en medio de ti.
es.B: Los testigos deben ser los primeros en levantar la mano para dar muerte a esa persona, y después todo el pueblo se unirá a ellos. Así eliminarás el mal de en medio de ti.
es.R: Los testigos deben tirar las primeras piedras, y después todos los demás deben unirse. Así es como debes librarte del mal que hay entre los tuyos.

fr.L: La main des témoins sera sur lui la première pour le faire mourir, et la main de tout le peuple ensuite. Ainsi tu ôteras le mal du milieu de toi.
fr.B: Les témoins seront les premiers à lever la main pour faire mourir cette personne, puis tout le peuple se joindra à eux. Ainsi tu feras disparaître le mal du milieu de toi.
fr.R: Les témoins doivent jeter les premières pierres, puis tous les autres doivent se joindre à eux. C’est ainsi que tu dois te débarrasser du mal qui est chez toi.

sw.L: Mkono wa mashahidi utakuwa juu yake kwanza ili kumuua, na mkono wa watu wote baadaye. Hivyo utauondoa uovu katikati yako.
sw.B: Mashahidi lazima wawe wa kwanza kuinua mikono yao ili kumuua mtu huyo, kisha watu wote wajiunge nao. Kwa njia hii utauondoa uovu kati yako.
sw.R: Mashahidi lazima warushe mawe ya kwanza, kisha watu wengine wote wajiunge nao. Hivi ndivyo unavyopaswa kuuondoa uovu ulio kati yako.

decisions.choice: the hand of the witnesses first: those who testify must begin the execution
decisions.reason: The witnesses have to stand behind their word with their own hands. A false witness would be taking a life, and the law punishes false testimony with the penalty it sought (19:16-19). The same order is given in 13:10.

decisions.choice: remove the evil from your midst: get rid of the evil completely
decisions.reason: The verb first means to burn, then to clear away completely. The saying recurs as a refrain in Deuteronomy's laws (13:6; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21-24; 24:7), and Paul quotes it in 1 Corinthians 5:13. "The evil" covers both the wrong done and the one who did it.

decisions.choice: throw the first stones
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the hand of" the witnesses and of the people. Readable says what the hand does, from verse 5.

decisions.choice: remove
decisions.reason: All levels say "remove" or "get rid of" rather than the verb's first sense, "burn", which here is a picture for clearing something away.

source.text: כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵא֩ מִמְּךָ֨דָבָ֜ר לַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט בֵּֽין־דָּ֨ם׀לְדָ֜ם בֵּֽין־דִּ֣ין לְדִ֗ין וּבֵ֥ין נֶ֨גַע֙ לָנֶ֔גַע דִּבְרֵ֥י רִיבֹ֖ת בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֣ וְעָלִ֔יתָ אֶל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: If is too difficult for you a matter for judgment, between blood and blood, between claim and claim, and between stroke and stroke, matters of disputes in your gates, then you shall arise and go up to the place which will choose Yahweh your God in it,

en.L: If a matter for judgment is too hard for you, between blood and blood, between claim and claim, and between blow and blow, matters of dispute within your gates, then you shall arise and go up to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose,
en.B: If a case is too hard for you to decide, whether it concerns bloodshed, legal claims or injuries, any kind of dispute in your towns, then you are to set out and go up to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose,
en.R: Some cases in your towns may be too hard for you to decide: cases of killing, cases about who has the right in a quarrel, or cases of someone hurting another person. Then go up to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose.

es.L: Si te es demasiado difícil un asunto de juicio, entre sangre y sangre, entre derecho y derecho, y entre golpe y golpe, asuntos de litigio en tus puertas, entonces te levantarás y subirás al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja,
es.B: Si un caso es demasiado difícil para que lo resuelvas, ya se trate de derramamiento de sangre, de reclamaciones legales o de lesiones, cualquier pleito en tus ciudades, entonces ponte en camino y sube al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja,
es.R: Puede que en tus ciudades haya casos demasiado difíciles de decidir: casos de muerte, casos sobre quién tiene la razón en una pelea, o casos de alguien que hirió a otra persona. Entonces sube al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja.

fr.L: Si une affaire est trop difficile pour toi à juger, entre sang et sang, entre droit et droit, et entre coup et coup, des affaires de contestation dans tes portes, alors tu te lèveras et tu monteras au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira,
fr.B: Si une affaire est trop difficile pour que tu la juges, qu’il s’agisse de sang versé, de droits contestés ou de blessures, de tout litige dans tes villes, alors tu te mettras en route et tu monteras au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira,
fr.R: Certaines affaires dans tes villes seront peut-être trop difficiles à juger pour toi : des affaires de meurtre, des disputes pour savoir qui a raison, ou des cas où quelqu’un a blessé une autre personne. Alors monte à l’endroit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira.

sw.L: Jambo la hukumu likiwa gumu mno kwako, kati ya damu na damu, kati ya dai na dai, na kati ya pigo na pigo, mambo ya mabishano ndani ya malango yako, basi utaondoka na kupanda kwenda mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako,
sw.B: Shauri likiwa gumu mno kwako kuliamua, liwe la umwagaji damu, la madai ya kisheria au la majeraha, ugomvi wowote katika miji yako, basi ondoka upande kwenda mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako,
sw.R: Huenda kesi fulani katika miji yako zikawa ngumu mno kwako kuziamua: kesi za mauaji, kesi za nani yuko sahihi katika ugomvi, au kesi za mtu aliyemwumiza mtu mwingine. Basi panda uende mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atapachagua.

decisions.choice: too difficult for you: beyond what the local court can settle
decisions.reason: The verb describes something out of reach or beyond understanding. The case is too hard for the judges appointed in each town (16:18), just as Moses once took the hard cases that the other judges could not decide (Exodus 18:22, 26).

decisions.choice: between blood and blood: deciding between one kind of killing and another
decisions.reason: "Blood" means a death by violence. Judges had to tell murder from accidental killing, which the law treats very differently (19:4-13; Exodus 21:12-14). "Claim and claim" are the rights of two parties in a dispute.

decisions.choice: between stroke and stroke: cases of assault and injury
alternatives: between one skin disease and another
decisions.reason: The word means a blow or a wound, as in the laws on injury (21:5; Exodus 21:18-27). The same word is also used for the skin disease that priests judge (24:8; Leviticus 13), and some take it in that sense here.

decisions.choice: the place the LORD your God will choose: the central sanctuary
decisions.reason: This is the one place God would choose for his name to dwell, where the offerings and festivals are brought (12:5, 11; 16:2). A higher court was to sit there, with the priests serving before the LORD (verses 9, 12).

decisions.choice: bloodshed, legal claims or injuries
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats each word, "between blood and blood". Balanced and Readable name the kinds of case instead; Literal keeps the pairs.

source.text: וּבָאתָ֗ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְאֶל־הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֙ וְהִגִּ֣ידוּ לְךָ֔ אֵ֖ת דְּבַ֥ר הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: and you shall come to the priests the Levites and to the judge who will be in the days those, and you shall inquire, and they shall declare to you the word of the judgment.

en.L: and you shall come to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge who will be in those days, and you shall inquire, and they shall declare to you the word of judgment.
en.B: and go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time. Ask them about the case, and they will give you the verdict.
en.R: Go to the priests, who are from the tribe of Levi, and to the judge who is serving at that time. Ask them, and they will tell you their decision.

es.L: y vendrás a los sacerdotes, los levitas, y al juez que haya en aquellos días, y consultarás, y ellos te declararán la palabra del juicio.
es.B: y acude a los sacerdotes levitas y al juez que esté en funciones en ese tiempo. Consúltales el caso, y ellos te darán el veredicto.
es.R: Ve a los sacerdotes, que son de la tribu de Leví, y al juez que esté sirviendo en ese tiempo. Pregúntales, y ellos te dirán su decisión.

fr.L: et tu viendras vers les prêtres, les Lévites, et vers le juge qui sera en ces jours-là, et tu [les] consulteras, et ils te déclareront la parole du jugement.
fr.B: et va trouver les prêtres lévites et le juge qui sera en fonction à ce moment-là. Consulte-les sur l’affaire, et ils te donneront le verdict.
fr.R: Va voir les prêtres, qui viennent de la tribu de Lévi, et le juge qui sera en service à ce moment-là. Pose-leur la question, et ils te diront leur décision.

sw.L: nawe utawaendea makuhani, Walawi, na mwamuzi atakayekuwepo siku hizo, nawe utauliza, nao watakujulisha neno la hukumu.
sw.B: na uwaendee makuhani Walawi na mwamuzi atakayekuwa kazini wakati huo. Waulize kuhusu shauri hilo, nao watakupa uamuzi.
sw.R: Nenda kwa makuhani, ambao ni wa kabila la Lawi, na kwa mwamuzi atakayekuwa akihudumu wakati huo. Waulize, nao watakuambia uamuzi wao.

decisions.choice: the priests, the Levites: the priests who come from the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy often calls the priests "the priests, the Levites" (18:1; 24:8; 31:9), stressing that the priesthood belongs to Levi's tribe.

decisions.choice: the judge who will be in those days: the judge holding office at the time
decisions.reason: The court at the sanctuary is made up of priests and a judge, who need not be a priest (19:17). Moses speaks of a time after his death, when such judges would follow one another in office.

decisions.choice: you shall inquire ... the word of judgment: you shall seek a ruling, and they will give the verdict
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or ask, here to put the case before the court. "The word of judgment" is the court's decision on it.

decisions.choice: in office at that time / serving at that time
decisions.reason: "Who will be in those days" means whoever is judge then. Balanced and Readable say so in today's words.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֗יתָ עַל־פִּ֤י הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַגִּ֣ידֽוּ לְךָ֔ מִן־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹרֽוּךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall do according to [the] mouth of the word which they declare to you from the place the that which will choose Yahweh, and you shall be careful to do according to all that they instruct you.

en.L: And you shall act according to the word that they declare to you from that place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose, and you shall be careful to do according to all that they direct you.
en.B: Then carry out the verdict they announce to you there, at the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose. Take care to follow all their directions exactly.
en.R: Then do what they tell you there, at the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose. Be careful to follow everything they teach you to do.

es.L: Y harás conforme a la palabra que te declaren desde aquel lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja, y cuidarás de hacer conforme a todo lo que te enseñen.
es.B: Después ejecuta el veredicto que te anuncien allí, en el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja. Cuida de seguir con exactitud todas sus indicaciones.
es.R: Luego haz lo que te digan allí, en el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja. Ten cuidado de seguir todo lo que te enseñen a hacer.

fr.L: Et tu agiras selon la parole qu’ils te déclareront de ce lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira, et tu veilleras à faire selon tout ce qu’ils t’enseigneront.
fr.B: Puis exécute le verdict qu’ils te feront connaître là-bas, au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira. Veille à suivre exactement toutes leurs directives.
fr.R: Ensuite, fais ce qu’ils te disent là-bas, à l’endroit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira. Fais bien attention à suivre tout ce qu’ils t’apprennent à faire.

sw.L: Nawe utatenda kulingana na neno watakalokujulisha kutoka mahali pale atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nawe utakuwa mwangalifu kutenda kulingana na yote watakayokuelekeza.
sw.B: Kisha tekeleza uamuzi watakaokutangazia huko, mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Uwe mwangalifu kufuata maelekezo yao yote kikamilifu.
sw.R: Kisha fanya wanachokuambia huko, mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua. Uwe mwangalifu kufuata kila kitu wanachokufundisha kufanya.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of the word: exactly as the verdict says
decisions.reason: "Mouth" is again the spoken word (verse 6). To act "on the mouth of" the decision is to carry it out as it was given, without changing it.

decisions.choice: they instruct you: they direct you, give you the ruling
decisions.reason: The verb means to point the way or to teach, and it is the root of the word for instruction in verse 11. Teaching the people God's ways was part of the priests' work (33:10; Leviticus 10:11).

decisions.choice: from that place that the LORD will choose: the verdict carries the authority of the place where God is worshiped
decisions.reason: The ruling is given at the sanctuary, before the LORD. That is why it binds the parties and the local court, and why defying it is so serious (verse 12).

decisions.choice: carry out ... take care to follow
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable split the verse into two sentences, one for doing what the court says and one for doing it carefully.

source.text: עַל־פִּ֨י הַתּוֹרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יוֹר֗וּךָ וְעַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְר֥וּ לְךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן־הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־יַגִּ֥ידֽוּ לְךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: According to [the] mouth of the instruction which they instruct you, and according to the judgment which they say to you, you shall do; not you shall turn aside from the word which they declare to you right or left.

en.L: According to the instruction that they teach you and according to the judgment that they tell you, you shall do; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, right or left.
en.B: Act on the instruction they give you and the ruling they announce to you. Do not turn aside from the verdict they declare to you, either to the right or to the left.
en.R: Follow the teaching they give you and do what they decide. Do not turn away from what they tell you in any way at all.

es.L: Conforme a la instrucción que te enseñen y conforme al juicio que te digan, harás; no te apartarás de la palabra que te declaren, ni a derecha ni a izquierda.
es.B: Actúa según la instrucción que te den y la decisión que te anuncien. No te desvíes del veredicto que te declaren, ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda.
es.R: Sigue la enseñanza que te den y haz lo que decidan. No te apartes en nada de lo que te digan.

fr.L: Selon l’instruction qu’ils t’enseigneront et selon le jugement qu’ils te diront, tu agiras ; tu ne t’écarteras pas de la parole qu’ils te déclareront, ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.B: Agis selon l’instruction qu’ils te donneront et la décision qu’ils t’annonceront. Ne t’écarte pas du verdict qu’ils te déclareront, ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.R: Suis l’enseignement qu’ils te donnent et fais ce qu’ils décident. Ne t’éloigne en rien de ce qu’ils te disent.

sw.L: Kulingana na mafundisho watakayokufundisha na kulingana na hukumu watakayokuambia, utatenda; usigeuke kutoka katika neno watakalokujulisha, kulia wala kushoto.
sw.B: Tenda kulingana na maelekezo watakayokupa na uamuzi watakaokutangazia. Usigeuke kuuacha uamuzi watakaokueleza, wala kulia wala kushoto.
sw.R: Fuata mafundisho wanayokupa na ufanye wanachoamua. Usiache kwa namna yoyote kile wanachokuambia.

decisions.choice: the instruction which they teach you: the direction the priests give on this case
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for "this law" in Deuteronomy, but here, joined to the verb "teach", it is the priests' instruction on a particular matter, as in Haggai 2:11. It is not the book of the law of verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: instruction, judgment, word: three names for the court's one decision
decisions.reason: The verse names the court's answer three ways and says three times that it must be followed. The repetition stresses that the ruling is final.

decisions.choice: not turn aside right or left: not depart from it at all
decisions.reason: The picture is of keeping to a road without straying to either side, as in 5:32 and 28:14. Verse 20 uses it for the king.

decisions.choice: in any way at all
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "to the right or to the left". Readable gives the sense of the picture.

source.text: וְהָאִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְזָד֗וֹן לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן֙ הָעֹמֵ֞ד לְשָׁ֤רֶת שָׁם֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ א֖וֹ אֶל־הַשֹּׁפֵ֑ט וּמֵת֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the man who acts with presumption, to not listen to the priest who stands to minister there [to] Yahweh your God, or to the judge, then shall die the man that; and you shall remove the evil from Israel.

en.L: And {{gender:the person|the man}} who acts presumptuously, not listening to the priest who stands to minister there to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, or to the judge, that {{gender:person|man}} shall die. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
en.B: Anyone who arrogantly refuses to listen to the priest who stands there serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, or to the judge, must die. In this way you will remove the evil from Israel.
en.R: Someone may be too proud to listen to the priest who serves {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God there, or to the judge. That person must die. This is how you must get rid of the evil in Israel.

es.L: Y {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que actúe con soberbia, no escuchando al sacerdote que está allí para servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, o al juez, {{gender:esa persona|ese hombre}} morirá. Así quitarás el mal de Israel.
es.B: Quien con arrogancia se niegue a escuchar al sacerdote que está allí sirviendo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, o al juez, debe morir. Así eliminarás el mal de Israel.
es.R: Puede que alguien sea demasiado orgulloso para escuchar al sacerdote que sirve allí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, o al juez. Esa persona debe morir. Así es como debes librarte del mal en Israel.

fr.L: Et {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} qui agira avec présomption, sans écouter le prêtre qui se tient là pour servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, ni le juge, {{gender:cette personne|cet homme}} mourra. Ainsi tu ôteras le mal d’Israël.
fr.B: Celui qui refusera avec arrogance d’écouter le prêtre qui se tient là au service {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, ou le juge, devra mourir. Ainsi tu feras disparaître le mal d’Israël.
fr.R: Quelqu’un sera peut-être trop orgueilleux pour écouter le prêtre qui sert {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu à cet endroit, ou le juge. Cette personne doit mourir. C’est ainsi que tu dois te débarrasser du mal en Israël.

sw.L: Na mtu atakayetenda kwa kiburi, asimsikilize kuhani anayesimama huko kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, au mwamuzi, mtu huyo atakufa. Hivyo utauondoa uovu katika Israeli.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote atakayekataa kwa kiburi kumsikiliza kuhani anayesimama huko akimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, au mwamuzi, lazima afe. Kwa njia hii utauondoa uovu katika Israeli.
sw.R: Huenda mtu akawa na kiburi kiasi cha kukataa kumsikiliza kuhani anayemtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko, au mwamuzi. Mtu huyo lazima afe. Hivi ndivyo unavyopaswa kuuondoa uovu katika Israeli.

decisions.choice: acts with presumption: acts in arrogant, deliberate defiance
decisions.reason: The word describes pride that sets itself above what God has ordered: a prophet who speaks without being sent (18:22), or someone who sins "with a high hand" (Numbers 15:30). It is not a mistake or a disagreement but a refusal to submit.

decisions.choice: the priest who stands to minister there: the priest on duty at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: "Standing" before the LORD is the posture of a servant ready to serve. The tribe of Levi was set apart to stand before the LORD and minister to him (10:8; 18:5, 7).

decisions.choice: the man: anyone, man or woman
decisions.reason: The word is "man", used of any person who defies the court. The law is not limited to men.

decisions.choice: he shall die: refusing the verdict is rebellion against the order God set
decisions.reason: The court gives its decision at the place God chose and through those who serve him. Defying it is treated like the other wrongs that must be removed from Israel (verse 7).

decisions.choice: the person / the man
decisions.reason: Literal offers "the person" by default, with "the man" as the traditional form, because anyone is meant (see the meaning decision). Balanced and Readable say "anyone" and "someone", which already include both.

decisions.choice: "mtu" with no gender span
alternatives: a span on "mtu" like the English "the person / the man"
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu" already means any person, man or woman, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change.

source.text: וְכָל־הָעָ֖ם יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְיִרָ֑אוּ וְלֹ֥א יְזִיד֖וּן עֽוֹד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And all the people shall hear and fear, and not shall they act presumptuously again.

en.L: And all the people shall hear and fear, and they shall not act presumptuously again.
en.B: All the people will hear of it and be afraid, and they will not act arrogantly again.
en.R: Then all the people will hear about it and be afraid. They will not dare to be so proud again.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo oirá y temerá, y no actuarán más con soberbia.
es.B: Todo el pueblo se enterará y tendrá temor, y nadie volverá a actuar con arrogancia.
es.R: Entonces todo el pueblo lo sabrá y tendrá miedo. Nadie se atreverá a ser tan orgulloso otra vez.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple entendra et craindra, et ils n’agiront plus avec présomption.
fr.B: Tout le peuple l’apprendra et sera saisi de crainte, et personne n’agira plus avec arrogance.
fr.R: Alors tout le peuple en entendra parler et aura peur. Personne n’osera plus être aussi orgueilleux.

sw.L: Na watu wote watasikia na kuogopa, wala hawatatenda kwa kiburi tena.
sw.B: Watu wote watasikia habari hiyo na kuogopa, wala hawatatenda kwa kiburi tena.
sw.R: Ndipo watu wote watasikia habari hiyo na kuogopa. Hawatathubutu tena kuwa na kiburi kama hicho.

decisions.choice: all the people shall hear and fear: the sentence is meant to warn others
decisions.reason: Punishment in public was also a warning to the whole people, as in 13:12; 19:20 and 21:21.

decisions.choice: act presumptuously: the verb from the same root as "presumption" in verse 12
decisions.reason: The verse picks up the word for the arrogant defiance of verse 12: once people see what it leads to, they will not act that way again.

decisions.choice: dare to
decisions.reason: Readable adds "dare" to bring out that fear will hold people back from such pride.

source.text: כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣א אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֖הּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְתָּה בָּ֑הּ וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ אָשִׂ֤ימָה עָלַי֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: When you come into the land which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you, and you take possession of it and dwell in it, and you say, Let me set over me a king like all the nations which [are] around me,

en.L: When you come into the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, and you take possession of it and dwell in it, and you say, 'I will set a king over me, like all the nations that [are] around me,'
en.B: Once you have entered the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, and you have taken possession of it and are living there, if you then say, 'Let us appoint a king over us, like all the nations that surround us,'
en.R: You will go into the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you. You will take it over and live there. Then you may say, 'We want a king to rule over us, like all the nations around us.'

es.L: Cuando entres en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, y tomes posesión de ella y habites en ella, y digas: “Pondré sobre mí un rey, como todas las naciones que [están] alrededor de mí”,
es.B: Una vez que hayas entrado en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, y hayas tomado posesión de ella y vivas allí, si entonces dices: “Pongamos un rey sobre nosotros, como todas las naciones que nos rodean”,
es.R: Vas a entrar en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da. La tomarás y vivirás en ella. Entonces tal vez digas: “Queremos un rey que nos gobierne, como todas las naciones que nos rodean.”

fr.L: Quand tu entreras dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, que tu en prendras possession et y habiteras, et que tu diras : “J’établirai un roi sur moi, comme toutes les nations qui [sont] autour de moi”,
fr.B: Une fois que tu seras entré dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, que tu en auras pris possession et que tu y habiteras, si tu dis alors : “Établissons un roi sur nous, comme toutes les nations qui nous entourent”,
fr.R: Tu vas entrer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne. Tu vas le prendre et y habiter. Alors tu diras peut-être : “Nous voulons un roi qui nous gouverne, comme toutes les nations autour de nous.”

sw.L: Utakapoingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa, na kuimiliki na kukaa ndani yake, nawe ukasema, 'Nitajiwekea mfalme juu yangu, kama mataifa yote yanayonizunguka,'
sw.B: Mara utakapokuwa umeingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa, na kuimiliki na kuishi humo, kisha ukasema, 'Tujiwekee mfalme juu yetu, kama mataifa yote yanayotuzunguka,'
sw.R: Utaingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa. Utaichukua na kuishi humo. Kisha huenda ukasema, 'Tunataka mfalme atutawale, kama mataifa yote yanayotuzunguka.'

decisions.choice: when ... you say: the law expects the people to ask for a king and permits it, within limits
decisions.reason: The judges of 16:18 are commanded; the king is not. The law starts from the people's own wish and sets out the conditions for a king (verses 15-20). The wish to be "like all the nations" is the very request made to Samuel (1 Samuel 8:5, 19-20).

decisions.choice: let me set over me: the nation speaking as one person
decisions.reason: As often in Deuteronomy, the people are addressed and speak as a single "you" and "I".

decisions.choice: you take possession of it and dwell in it: the king belongs to the time after the land is settled
decisions.reason: Israel had no king in the wilderness or during the conquest. The law looks ahead to a settled people living in their own land.

decisions.choice: us
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "me", the people speaking as one. Balanced and Readable say "us", since in English a whole people speaks of itself as "we".

source.text: שׂ֣וֹם תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב אַחֶ֗יךָ תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָתֵ֤ת עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נָכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־אָחִ֖יךָ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely you shall set over you a king whom chooses Yahweh your God in him; from [the] midst of your brothers you shall set over you a king; not you may set over you a man foreign who not your brother [is] he.

en.L: you may indeed set over you a king whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God chooses. From among your brothers you shall set a king over you; you may not set over you a foreign man, who is not your brother.
en.B: you may indeed set a king over you, but it must be the one {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God chooses. Set over you a king from among your fellow Israelites; you may not put a foreigner over you, someone who is not one of your own people.
en.R: You may have a king, but he must be the one {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God chooses. He must be an Israelite, one of your own people. Do not make a foreigner your king.

es.L: ciertamente podrás poner sobre ti un rey al que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja. De en medio de tus hermanos pondrás un rey sobre ti; no podrás poner sobre ti a un hombre extranjero, que no sea tu hermano.
es.B: podrás en efecto poner un rey sobre ti, pero tendrá que ser el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja. Pon sobre ti un rey de entre tus compatriotas; no podrás poner sobre ti a un extranjero, a alguien que no sea de tu propio pueblo.
es.R: Puedes tener un rey, pero debe ser el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escoja. Debe ser israelita, uno de tu propio pueblo. No hagas rey a un extranjero.

fr.L: tu pourras bien établir sur toi un roi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira. C’est du milieu de tes frères que tu établiras un roi sur toi ; tu ne pourras pas établir sur toi un homme étranger, qui n’est pas ton frère.
fr.B: tu pourras en effet établir un roi sur toi, mais ce devra être celui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira. Établis sur toi un roi pris parmi tes {{gender:compatriotes|frères}} ; tu ne pourras pas mettre au-dessus de toi un étranger, quelqu’un qui n’est pas de ton peuple.
fr.R: Tu peux avoir un roi, mais il doit être celui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu choisira. Il doit être israélite, quelqu’un de ton propre peuple. Ne prends pas un étranger pour roi.

sw.L: unaweza kweli kujiwekea mfalme juu yako ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atamchagua. Kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zako utajiwekea mfalme juu yako; huwezi kujiwekea juu yako mtu wa kigeni, ambaye si ndugu yako.
sw.B: unaweza kweli kujiwekea mfalme, lakini lazima awe yule ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atamchagua. Jiwekee mfalme kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zako Waisraeli; huruhusiwi kumweka juu yako mtu wa taifa jingine, ambaye si wa watu wako.
sw.R: Unaweza kuwa na mfalme, lakini lazima awe yule ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atamchagua. Lazima awe Mwisraeli, mmoja wa watu wako. Usimfanye mtu wa taifa jingine kuwa mfalme wako.

decisions.choice: surely you shall set: you may indeed set, the stress falling on the condition that follows
alternatives: you must set a king over you
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. After verse 14 it grants what the people ask, but its weight falls on "whom the LORD your God chooses". Some read it as a firm command to appoint a king.

decisions.choice: whom the LORD your God chooses: the king is God's choice, not only the people's
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the place God chooses (verses 8, 10). Later God chooses Saul and then David, and the prophet anoints them (1 Samuel 10:24; 16:1-13).

decisions.choice: your brothers ... a foreign man: a fellow Israelite, not a foreigner
decisions.reason: "Brother" here means a member of the same people, as in 15:3, 7 and 12. A foreign ruler would not belong to the covenant people or be bound by its law.

decisions.choice: fellow Israelites / one of your own people
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "brothers". Balanced and Readable say what the word means here, a member of the same people.

decisions.choice: "mtu wa kigeni" (L), "mtu wa taifa jingine" (B, R) for the foreign man
decisions.reason: "Mgeni" is kept for the sojourner living in Israel (ger). The word here means someone of another nation, so Swahili follows the wording used for the foreigner in Leviticus 22.

source.text: רַק֮ לֹא־יַרְבֶּה־לּ֣וֹ סוּסִים֒ וְלֹֽא־יָשִׁ֤יב אֶת־הָעָם֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לְמַ֖עַן הַרְבּ֣וֹת ס֑וּס וַֽיהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר לָכֶ֔ם לֹ֣א תֹסִפ֗וּן לָשׁ֛וּב בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ הַזֶּ֖ה עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Only not he shall multiply for himself horses, and not he shall make return the people to Egypt in order to multiply horse[s], and Yahweh has said to you, Not you shall again return on the way the this again.

en.L: Only he shall not multiply horses for himself, and he shall not make the people return to Egypt in order to multiply horses, since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said to you, 'You shall not return on this way again.'
en.B: But he must not build up a large number of horses for himself, or send the people back to Egypt to get more horses, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has told you, 'You must never go back that way again.'
en.R: But the king must not get many horses for himself. He must not send people back to Egypt to get more horses. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has told you, 'Never go back there again.'

es.L: Solamente que no multiplicará para sí caballos, ni hará volver al pueblo a Egipto para multiplicar caballos, pues {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dicho: “No {{plural_you:volverán|volveréis}} nunca más por este camino.”
es.B: Pero no deberá juntar gran cantidad de caballos para sí, ni enviar al pueblo de regreso a Egipto para conseguir más caballos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dicho: “Nunca más {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} volver por ese camino.”
es.R: Pero el rey no debe tener muchos caballos. No debe mandar gente de vuelta a Egipto para conseguir más caballos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dicho: “Nunca más {{plural_you:vuelvan|volváis}} allá.”

fr.L: Seulement, il ne multipliera pas pour lui les chevaux, et il ne fera pas retourner le peuple en Égypte afin de multiplier les chevaux, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a dit : “Vous ne retournerez plus par ce chemin-là.”
fr.B: Mais il ne devra pas se procurer un grand nombre de chevaux, ni renvoyer le peuple en Égypte pour avoir plus de chevaux, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a dit : “Vous ne devez plus jamais reprendre ce chemin.”
fr.R: Mais le roi ne doit pas avoir beaucoup de chevaux. Il ne doit pas renvoyer des gens en Égypte pour avoir plus de chevaux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a dit : “Ne retournez plus jamais là-bas.”

sw.L: Ila asijiongezee farasi wengi, wala asiwarudishe watu Misri ili apate kuongeza farasi, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaambia ninyi, 'Msirudi tena katika njia hii kamwe.'
sw.B: Lakini asijikusanyie idadi kubwa ya farasi, wala asiwarudishe watu Misri ili kupata farasi zaidi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaambia, 'Kamwe msirudi tena njia ile.'
sw.R: Lakini mfalme asijipatie farasi wengi. Asiwapeleke watu Misri tena ili kupata farasi zaidi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaambia, 'Msirudi huko tena kamwe.'

decisions.choice: multiply horses: build up a force of chariots and horsemen
decisions.reason: Horses were used above all for war chariots, the great military power of the time (20:1). Trusting in them instead of the LORD is condemned (Isaiah 31:1; Psalm 20:8). Solomon later gathered horses and chariots and brought horses from Egypt (1 Kings 10:26-29).

decisions.choice: make the people return to Egypt: send people to Egypt to obtain horses
alternatives: trade Israelites to Egypt in payment for horses
decisions.reason: The text does not say how the people would be sent back. It may mean sending envoys and traders to buy horses, or paying for them with men sent to serve Egypt as soldiers or laborers. Either way the people would be drawn back toward the land they were freed from.

decisions.choice: the LORD has said to you: a word not found earlier in this form
decisions.reason: No earlier passage gives this saying in these words. It sums up the meaning of the exodus: Israel is not to go back to Egypt (Exodus 13:17; 14:13). At the end of the curses, being taken back to Egypt is the worst reversal of all (28:68).

decisions.choice: build up a large number / get many
decisions.reason: The verb means "make many". Balanced and Readable use everyday words for gathering a large number.

decisions.choice: "les ha dicho" ("os ha dicho" in the vosotros setting) and the plural verb inside the quotation
alternatives: "te ha dicho", singular as in the rest of the chapter
decisions.reason: Here alone in the chapter the Hebrew says "you" in the plural, so Spanish uses the plural with its plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "vous a dit" and "Vous ne retournerez plus", plural
alternatives: "t'a dit", singular as in the rest of the chapter
decisions.reason: Here alone in the chapter the Hebrew says "you" in the plural, both for those the LORD spoke to and in his words. French follows the Hebrew number.

decisions.choice: "amewaambia" and "msirudi", plural
alternatives: "amekuambia", singular as in the rest of the chapter
decisions.reason: Here alone in the chapter the Hebrew says "you" in the plural. Swahili follows the Hebrew number; Literal adds the free pronoun "ninyi" to bring out the change.

source.text: וְלֹ֤א יַרְבֶּה־לּוֹ֙ נָשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָס֖וּר לְבָב֑וֹ וְכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א יַרְבֶּה־לּ֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And not he shall multiply for himself wives, and not shall turn aside his heart; and silver and gold not he shall multiply for himself greatly.

en.L: And he shall not multiply wives for himself, so that his heart does not turn aside; and silver and gold he shall not multiply for himself greatly.
en.B: He must not take many wives for himself, or his heart will be led astray. And he must not pile up great amounts of silver and gold for himself.
en.R: He must not marry many wives, or his heart will turn away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And he must not gather huge amounts of silver and gold for himself.

es.L: Y no multiplicará para sí mujeres, para que no se desvíe su corazón; y plata y oro no multiplicará para sí en gran manera.
es.B: No deberá tomar muchas esposas, no sea que su corazón se desvíe. Y no deberá amontonar para sí grandes cantidades de plata y oro.
es.R: No debe casarse con muchas mujeres, porque su corazón se apartaría {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y no debe juntar para sí enormes cantidades de plata y oro.

fr.L: Et il ne multipliera pas pour lui les femmes, afin que son cœur ne se détourne pas ; et l’argent et l’or, il ne les multipliera pas beaucoup pour lui.
fr.B: Il ne devra pas prendre beaucoup de femmes, sinon son cœur se laisserait égarer. Et il ne devra pas amasser pour lui de grandes quantités d’argent et d’or.
fr.R: Il ne doit pas épouser beaucoup de femmes, sinon son cœur se détournera {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et il ne doit pas accumuler pour lui d’énormes quantités d’argent et d’or.

sw.L: Wala asijiongezee wake wengi, moyo wake usije ukageuka; wala asijiongezee fedha na dhahabu kwa wingi mno.
sw.B: Asijitwalie wake wengi, la sivyo moyo wake utapotoshwa. Wala asijilimbikizie kiasi kikubwa cha fedha na dhahabu.
sw.R: Asioe wake wengi, la sivyo moyo wake utageuka kumwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wala asijikusanyie kiasi kikubwa mno cha fedha na dhahabu.

decisions.choice: many wives: royal marriages that bound a king to other nations and their gods
decisions.reason: Kings took many wives, often daughters of foreign kings to seal alliances. Deuteronomy warns that foreign marriages lead to the worship of other gods (7:3-4).

decisions.choice: his heart turn aside: his loyalty turn away from the LORD
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. To have one's heart turn aside is to stop following the LORD (11:16; 29:17).

decisions.choice: silver and gold: wealth gathered for the king himself
decisions.reason: The three limits on the king (horses, wives, wealth) are all broken by Solomon, whose riches are described in 1 Kings 10:14-27 and whose wives "turned away his heart" (1 Kings 11:1-4).

decisions.choice: turn away from the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says from whom the heart turns away, as the meaning decision explains. Literal and Balanced leave it unstated, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה כְשִׁבְתּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֑וֹ וְכָ֨תַב ל֜וֹ אֶת־מִשְׁנֵ֨ה הַתּוֹרָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ עַל־סֵ֔פֶר מִלִּפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it shall be, when he sits on [the] throne of his kingdom, then he shall write for himself a copy of the law the this on a scroll from before the priests the Levites.

en.L: And it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write for himself a copy of this law on a scroll, from before the priests, the Levites.
en.B: When he takes his seat on the throne of his kingdom, he is to write out for himself a copy of this law on a scroll, from the one kept by the Levitical priests.
en.R: When he becomes king, he must write out his own copy of this teaching on a scroll. He is to copy it from the scroll that the priests from the tribe of Levi keep.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando se siente sobre el trono de su reino, escribirá para sí una copia de esta ley en un rollo, de delante de los sacerdotes, los levitas.
es.B: Cuando ocupe el trono de su reino, deberá escribir para sí una copia de esta ley en un rollo, a partir del que guardan los sacerdotes levitas.
es.R: Cuando llegue a ser rey, debe escribir su propia copia de esta enseñanza en un rollo. Debe copiarla del rollo que guardan los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand il s’assiéra sur le trône de son royaume, qu’il écrira pour lui une copie de cette loi sur un rouleau, d’auprès des prêtres, les Lévites.
fr.B: Quand il prendra place sur le trône de son royaume, il devra écrire pour lui-même une copie de cette loi sur un rouleau, d’après celui que gardent les prêtres lévites.
fr.R: Quand il deviendra roi, il devra écrire sa propre copie de cet enseignement sur un rouleau. Il la recopiera d’après le rouleau que gardent les prêtres de la tribu de Lévi.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, atakapoketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake, atajiandikia nakala ya sheria hii katika gombo, kutoka mbele ya makuhani, Walawi.
sw.B: Atakapoketi kwenye kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake, atajiandikia nakala ya sheria hii katika gombo, kutoka kwa lile linalotunzwa na makuhani Walawi.
sw.R: Atakapokuwa mfalme, lazima ajiandikie nakala yake mwenyewe ya mafundisho haya katika gombo. Ataiandika kutoka katika gombo wanalolitunza makuhani wa kabila la Lawi.

decisions.choice: a copy: a duplicate written out from the original
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to repeat" or "to do a second time", and means a second one, a double, a copy. Joshua writes "a copy of the law of Moses" on stones (Joshua 8:32).

decisions.choice: a copy of this law: the phrase that gave the book its name
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation rendered these words as "this second law". From that phrase the book came to be called Deuteronomy, "second law". The Hebrew means a copy of the law, not a new or second law; the Hebrew title of the book is its opening words, "These are the words" (1:1).

decisions.choice: this law: the whole of Moses' teaching in this book
decisions.reason: As in 1:5, "this law" is the instruction Moses gives in Deuteronomy, which he later writes down and gives to the priests (31:9, 24-26).

decisions.choice: from before the priests: copied from the scroll in the priests' keeping
alternatives: in the presence of the Levitical priests
decisions.reason: The phrase means "from what is in front of" the priests. It most likely means the king copies the scroll the priests keep beside the ark (31:9, 26). It could also mean that he writes it in their presence, under their oversight.

decisions.choice: this teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for the word Literal and Balanced render "law", as in 1:5.

decisions.choice: from the one kept by
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the scroll the priests keep, following the meaning decision. Literal keeps the open "from before".

source.text: וְהָיְתָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְקָ֥רָא ב֖וֹ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑יו לְמַ֣עַן יִלְמַ֗ד לְיִרְאָה֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו לִ֠שְׁמֹר אֶֽת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֞י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all [the] days of his life, so that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all [the] words of the law the this and the statutes the these, to do them,

en.L: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them,
en.B: He must keep it with him and read from it all his life, so that he learns to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, carefully keeping every word of this law and these statutes and doing them,
en.R: He must keep the scroll with him and read it every day of his life. Then he will learn to fear and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. He will learn to obey every word of this teaching and these laws.

es.L: Y estará con él, y leerá en ella todos los días de su vida, para que aprenda a temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, para guardar todas las palabras de esta ley y estos estatutos, para hacerlos,
es.B: Deberá tenerla consigo y leer en ella toda su vida, para que aprenda a temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, guardando con cuidado todas las palabras de esta ley y estos estatutos, y poniéndolos en práctica,
es.R: Debe tener el rollo consigo y leerlo todos los días de su vida. Así aprenderá a temer y honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Aprenderá a obedecer cada palabra de esta enseñanza y de estas leyes.

fr.L: Et elle sera avec lui, et il y lira tous les jours de sa vie, afin qu’il apprenne à craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, à garder toutes les paroles de cette loi et ces prescriptions, pour les pratiquer,
fr.B: Il devra la garder avec lui et la lire toute sa vie, afin d’apprendre à craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, en gardant avec soin toutes les paroles de cette loi et ces prescriptions, et en les mettant en pratique,
fr.R: Il doit garder le rouleau avec lui et le lire tous les jours de sa vie. Ainsi il apprendra à craindre et à honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu. Il apprendra à obéir à chaque parole de cet enseignement et de ces lois.

sw.L: Nayo itakuwa pamoja naye, naye atasoma ndani yake siku zote za maisha yake, ili ajifunze kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kuyashika maneno yote ya sheria hii na kanuni hizi, kuzitenda,
sw.B: Lazima aiweke pamoja naye na kuisoma maisha yake yote, ili ajifunze kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, akiyashika kwa uangalifu maneno yote ya sheria hii na kanuni hizi na kuyatenda,
sw.R: Lazima aliweke gombo hilo pamoja naye na alisome kila siku ya maisha yake. Ndipo atajifunza kumcha na kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. Atajifunza kutii kila neno la mafundisho haya na sheria hizi.

decisions.choice: learn to fear the LORD: learn reverent awe of God that shows itself in obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD in Deuteronomy is to hold him in awe and so to keep his commands (4:10; 6:2, 24). It is learned by hearing and reading his words, as with the tithe meal in 14:23 and the public reading in 31:12-13.

decisions.choice: he shall read in it ... to keep all the words: the king stands under the law like everyone else
decisions.reason: The only duty this law gives the king is to read the law and keep it. He is not its master but its first student.

decisions.choice: all the days of his life: as long as he lives, again and again
decisions.reason: The phrase means his whole life long, and implies regular reading rather than a single reading.

decisions.choice: statutes: the fixed rules of the law
decisions.reason: This is the usual word for the laws God has set, often paired with "rulings" and "commandments" (4:1; 6:1).

decisions.choice: fear and honor
decisions.reason: Readable adds "honor" so that "fear" is not taken only as being afraid; the word means reverent awe (see the meaning decision). Readable says "teaching" and "laws" for "law" and "statutes", as elsewhere in Deuteronomy.

source.text: לְבִלְתִּ֤י רוּם־לְבָבוֹ֙ מֵֽאֶחָ֔יו וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י ס֥וּר מִן־הַמִּצְוָ֖ה יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַעַן֩ יַאֲרִ֨יךְ יָמִ֧ים עַל־מַמְלַכְתּ֛וֹ ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו בְּקֶ֥רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: so that not is lifted up his heart above his brothers, and so that not he turns aside from the commandment right or left, so that he may lengthen days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in [the] midst of Israel.

en.L: so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and so that he may not turn aside from the commandment, right or left, so that he may lengthen [his] days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.
en.B: so that he does not think himself above his fellow Israelites or stray from the commandment to the right or the left. Then he and his descendants will reign over his kingdom in Israel for a long time.
en.R: Then he will not think he is better than the other Israelites, and he will not turn away from what God commands in any way at all. And he and his sons after him will rule Israel for many years.

es.L: para que no se eleve su corazón sobre sus hermanos, y para que no se aparte del mandamiento, ni a derecha ni a izquierda, a fin de que prolongue [sus] días sobre su reino, él y sus hijos, en medio de Israel.
es.B: para que no se crea superior a sus compatriotas ni se desvíe del mandamiento ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda. Así él y sus descendientes reinarán por mucho tiempo sobre su reino en Israel.
es.R: Así no pensará que es mejor que los demás israelitas, y no se apartará en nada de lo que Dios manda. Y él y sus hijos después de él gobernarán Israel durante muchos años.

fr.L: afin que son cœur ne s’élève pas au-dessus de ses frères, et qu’il ne s’écarte pas du commandement, ni à droite ni à gauche, afin qu’il prolonge [ses] jours sur son royaume, lui et ses fils, au milieu d’Israël.
fr.B: afin qu’il ne se croie pas au-dessus de ses {{gender:compatriotes|frères}} et ne s’écarte pas du commandement, ni à droite ni à gauche. Alors lui et ses descendants régneront longtemps sur son royaume en Israël.
fr.R: Ainsi, il ne se croira pas meilleur que les autres Israélites, et il ne s’éloignera en rien de ce que Dieu commande. Et lui et ses fils après lui régneront sur Israël pendant de nombreuses années.

sw.L: ili moyo wake usijiinue juu ya ndugu zake, na ili asigeuke kutoka katika amri, kulia wala kushoto, ili apate kuzidisha siku [zake] katika ufalme wake, yeye na wanawe, katikati ya Israeli.
sw.B: ili asijione kuwa bora kuliko ndugu zake Waisraeli wala asiiache amri kwa kugeuka kulia au kushoto. Ndipo yeye na wazao wake watatawala ufalme wake katika Israeli kwa muda mrefu.
sw.R: Ndipo hatajiona kuwa bora kuliko Waisraeli wengine, wala hataacha kwa namna yoyote kile Mungu anachoamuru. Naye pamoja na wanawe baada yake watatawala Israeli kwa miaka mingi.

decisions.choice: his heart lifted up above his brothers: pride that sets the king above his people
decisions.reason: A lifted-up heart is pride (8:14). The king remains a "brother" among his people (verse 15), not a lord set above them.

decisions.choice: the commandment: the whole of what God commands
decisions.reason: The singular word gathers up the whole charge God gives, as in 5:31; 6:1 and 8:1.

decisions.choice: lengthen days over his kingdom, he and his sons: a long reign and a lasting line of kings
decisions.reason: The promise of long life given to all who obey (4:40; 5:33) is here applied to the king's reign and to his sons who succeed him.

decisions.choice: right or left: as in verse 11, not departing at all
decisions.reason: The same picture of keeping to the road is used for the people and the court in verse 11 and for the king here.

decisions.choice: fellow Israelites; descendants / sons after him
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "brothers" and "sons". Balanced says "fellow Israelites" (as in verse 15) and "descendants", the line of kings after him; Readable "the other Israelites" and "his sons after him".

decisions.choice: what God commands in any way at all
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly whose commandment is meant and gives the sense of "right or left", as in verse 11.
